steps.action: A deployment SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM make the wizard relay read-only and take over the sender
steps.actual: Under applied phase env (55d555a132d1099704fd5da7b8f6c469191b55e1b7ebab0e40da91d4e56f1e82, 2026-09-08T03:33:25.538141+00:00) the pane read "Outbound email is set by the deployment environment." and showed deployment@northwind.example. No SMTP relay URL field and no Save relay or Clear relay control was present, so the wizard was read-only. The resolved source was env even though a complete app relay (legal@helix.example) was stored first.

steps.action: A real invitation sent under the environment override arrives from the environment sender
steps.actual: The invitation to Ingrid Sollberg was delivered while the override was active and its envelope From was deployment@northwind.example, the environment sender, not the stored legal@helix.example. This proves the environment value is what actually sends, not merely what the pane displays.
